decision.decision: The restock is ordered and paid. Purchase order #1 is for 1 x CC-TEE-WHITE size S from Bulldog Print Co, and the vendor expects it on 2026-09-05. Draft 5 tells Tauhid Zaman that date and replaces draft 1, which is out of date. The ticket is now waiting on the vendor.
decision.reasoning: Ken Rice approved both payments for this ticket, and both are paid. Request #1 paid invoice 501 ($840.00, 3 days overdue on 2026-08-31), so Bulldog Print Co can ship again. Request #3 paid purchase order #1 ($8.00, 1 x CC-TEE-WHITE S at the $8.00 unit cost). The purchase order is 'ordered' with an expected arrival of 2026-09-05. Size S is still at 0 on hand, so nothing can be set aside yet. Draft 1 said no date could be promised. That is outdated now that the order is placed, so Customer Service saved draft 5 with the 2026-09-05 estimate. No more money is needed for this ticket. A person is still needed to review and send draft 5.
next_steps: Owner: review draft 5 and send it to Tauhid Zaman, then delete draft 1 so the old 'no firm date' message isn't sent by mistake.

When purchase order #1 arrives (expected 2026-09-05), run ticket 101 again. Inventory should log the received unit and set aside 1 x CC-TEE-WHITE S for Tauhid Zaman, and Customer Service should draft a 'ready for pickup' note.
If nothing has arrived by 2026-09-05, Inventory should check the order status with Bulldog Print Co, and Customer Service should draft an honest update to the customer.
